headline: Six Fronts Stir as Base Ledgers Turn
war_summary: Since the last edition, the base ledger has grown livelier on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the chief unsettled sector, with 43 events in 24 hours and two in the latest watch; its balance has shifted to four Warden, two Colonial, and three neutral positions. Linn Mercy has added three daily events, including five in the last two hours, while retaining ten Colonial bases and one neutral. Mooring County has sharply revived, rising to 15 daily events with eight in the latest two-hour window, though its standing remains eleven Warden and one Colonial. Callahans Passage has newly registered six events, four of them in the latest watch, amid very heavy casualty totals; its ledger shows nine Warden and one Colonial base. Nevish Line remains a hard-fought but presently quiet front for base movement, with 45 events over the day and ten in six hours. Stonecradle likewise records no fresh movement after 14 daily events. Other sectors show little or no recent base activity, leaving these six the principal watches for the next day.
